heroHeadline: UNICEF: One Palestinian Child Killed Per Week in West Bank Since 2025 — Haredi Bloc Triggers Coalition Crisis Over Draft Exemption Freeze
heroSubtitle: UNICEF published a landmark report on May 12, 2026 documenting that 70 Palestinian children have been killed in the West Bank and East Jerusalem since January 2025 — approximately one per week — with over 800 injured; 93% were killed by Israeli forces, the remainder by settlers or unexploded ordnance. UNICEF spokesperson James Elder called it 'a sustained pattern of the worst kind of violation.' Simultaneously, Israel's governing coalition entered fresh crisis: Rabbi Dov Lando, spiritual leader of the Degel HaTorah Haredi faction, ordered his party's Knesset members to support dissolving parliament after PM Netanyahu froze the ultra-Orthodox military draft exemption bill before October 2026 elections. The Knesset separately voted on May 12 to establish a special tribunal and authorize the death penalty for October 7 perpetrators — the first time Israel has authorized capital punishment for a specific crime category since Eichmann's execution in 1962. Finance Minister Smotrich publicly declared 'We are building the Land of Israel and destroying the idea of a Palestinian state' in response to settler uprooting of 3,000 Palestinian trees, as settlers also occupied the Ein Sala spring near Ramallah (Abwein and Jilijliya villages). The IDF confirmed killing four Palestinian operatives in Gaza on May 12, with the cumulative post-ceasefire death toll reaching approximately 880+. The broader Gaza war death toll since October 7, 2023 stands at 72,737+ documented, with the true toll estimated to exceed 90,000–100,000.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OCHA, IDF, Gaza Ministry of Health, B'Tselem, ICC, ICJ, Reuters, Al Jazeera, OHCHR, UNRWA, Times of Israel, Haaretz, Bloomberg, Jerusalem Post, Human Rights Watch, Save the Children, Amnesty International, UNICEF, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are subject to ongoing verification. The conflict has persisted since Israeli independence on May 14, 1948.
